expression: log1p(CPM) of corrected-count sums by existing group; ALL original features retained in normalization denominators. Highest pooled-abundance feature selected per duplicate gene symbol.
signature: For each gene and group: aggregate log1p(CPM) minus aggregate log1p(CPM) of all other retained ventricular-enriched groups in the same stage.
feature_rules: Exclude mt-/Rpl/Rps/Gm-prefixed and listed sex-associated symbols. Require >=5 aggregate CPM in at least one group and absolute within-stage contrast>=0.4 in at least one group. Thresholds are exploratory, not calibrated.
similarity: Spearman correlation across selected relative gene signatures. Export every cross-stage pair, rank and reciprocal top match; ranks always exist even for weak similarities and do not establish identity.
sensitivity: Repeat after withholding every gene in previously interpreted microenvironment programs, 94-gene literature checks and 17-gene electrical/regional checks.
marker_overlap: Shared top80 previously selected markers with positive corrected/raw effects in both libraries; truncated discovery lists, not an independent validation set.
limits: Aggregate signatures pool libraries and can be affected by library weighting, relative stage composition, age and technical differences. This is not sample-level differential expression.
Previous within-library/raw/QC support is retained in catalog; new whole-transcriptome matching is corrected-count only, with interpreted-gene exclusion sensitivity.
No batch-adjusted counts, forced one-to-one mapping, trajectory, ancestry or functional verification.
A family can split/merge with development. Missing counterparts mean not resolved, not biological absence.
Stage-specific UMAP coordinates are not used to match groups.
